card.name: The abbreviation PN for parenteral nutrition
card.fires_on: The abbreviation "PN" (parenteral nutrition) in injection labels, usually after "in", "the" or "as a" and before words like admixture, solution or container.

modes.label: PN admixture or solution
modes.description: PN follows "in" or "as a" in directions on mixing an additive into nutrition solutions.
modes.example: Prior to administration, ELCYS® must be diluted and used as an admixture in<< PN>> solutions.

modes.label: PN container or therapy
modes.description: PN names the bag or the therapy itself, as in transfer to the container or giving PN to patients.
